description: This Java source file defines the class LegacyPingMessageEvent, which extends LegacyApsAckedCommandEvent. The class represents a specific type of event related to legacy ping messages in a Zigbee core simulation or mocking environment. It includes methods for encoding a payload buffer specific to this event type.
